name: Presidential popular vote margin (D−R)
description: Two-party share, Democratic minus Republican; positive means Democratic. Each result stands until the next election.

origin.dataset: Federal Elections: official results for president

migration.note: v1's votes were read from Wikipedia. The register's Wikipedia row says to enter them from the official record instead, each with its citation. The hand-entered file format and its adapter exist (M16) and the register has a proposed row for the Federal Election Commission; no value is entered until Alex has decided that row.
